## Change

Explain the user outcome and scope. No real business data or sensitive screenshots.

## Checks actually performed

- [ ] Typecheck, lint and relevant unit/service/browser tests
- [ ] Server-side permission/ownership/version and audit behavior
- [ ] Migration/data-retention/backward-compatibility implications
- [ ] Keyboard, loading, empty/error and desktop/mobile behavior
- [ ] Documentation and dependency/license changes
- [ ] No secrets, company data/assets, database files, uploads or generated reports

List checks not run and why. A passing build does not establish production approval.
